simple.summary: דָּלַק (dâlaq) means to flame (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 17 53.

definitions.usage: burning, chase, inflame, kindle, persecute(-or), pursue hotly.
definitions.full: H1814. dalaq דָּלַק verb burn (intransitive), hotly pursue (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic דְּלַק , all intransitive burn, kindle ; Hiph`il, Aph`el transitive) — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular דָּלַקְתָּ Gen 31:36 ; 3 masculine plural וְדָֽלְקוּ consecutive Obadiah 18; suffix דְּלָקֻנִי Lam 4:19 ; Imperfect יִדְלַק Psa 10:2 ; Infinitive construct דְּלֹק 1Sam 17:53 ; Participle active plural דֹּלְקִים Psa 7:14 ; Prov 26:23 ; — 1 burn , בָהֶם וְדָֽלְקוּ Obadiah 18 (figurative of Israel ravaging among Edomites, || וַאֲכָלוּם ; on construction with בְּ compare 2Kin 17:25 ); also in יִפְעָ֑ל לְדֹלְקִים חִצָּיו Psa 7:14 his arrows he maketh burning ones (subject God) RV De Che and others; & דֹּלְקִים שְׂפָתַיִם Prov 26:23 burning (fervent) lips (opposed to רָ֑ע לֵב ). 2 hotly pursue Gen 31:36 (E; followed by אַחֲרֵי ) 1Sam 17:53 (followed by id.); Psa 10:2 ; Lam 4:19 (both followed by accusative) Hiph`il Imperfect suffix יַדְלִיקֵם Isa 5:11 ; Imperative הַדְלֵק Ezek 24:10 ; — inflame , with accusative, subject wine Isa 5:11 ; kindle object הָאֵשׁ Ezek 24:10 . [ דְּלַק ] verb burn (Biblical Hebrew); — Pe`al Participle active דָּלִ֑ק (K § 29, 1 ) Dan 7:9 burning fire.
